sentences.text: [curious] Same ten thousand dollars a month.
After five years, one couple has ninety thousand dollars saved. The other has twenty-two thousand eight hundred.
On the first, ten thousand lands for both of them. Couple B moves fifteen hundred to savings before anything else.
Mid-month, couple A spends as it comes. Couple B spends from a daily number, and when they overspend, tomorrow adjusts.
By the twenty-fourth, couple A has two hundred and twelve dollars left. Couple B is on track.
This month, couple A saves three hundred and eighty dollars. Couple B saves fifteen hundred.
